effects.does: Opens the Clara AI assistant panel for the project.
effects.affects: loads AI suggestions based on current line items
effects.check: Verify that clicking the button displays the Clara panel and shows AI‑generated questions.

effects.does: Opens a file‑picker dialog to attach files to the project.
effects.affects: adds attachment objects to `terms_and_conditions.attachments` in the draft payload
effects.check: Select a file and confirm it appears in the attachment list.

effects.does: Opens a modal to add or edit terms and conditions text.
effects.affects: populates `terms_and_conditions.clauses` in the draft payload
effects.check: Enter text, save and verify it is reflected in the T&C preview area.

effects.does: Adds a new empty line‑item row to the items table.
effects.affects: creates a new line‑item object with status `draft` in the UI state
effects.check: Click the button and confirm a new row appears with required columns highlighted.

effects.does: Saves the current project as a draft.
effects.affects: POSTs or PATCHes the event_group with `status:"draft"` and stores stage UUIDs
effects.check: After click, verify a success toast and that the draft can be reopened later.

effects.does: Publishes the project (or sends it to the auction team).
effects.affects: PATCHes the event_group with `status:"active"` (or sends to auction team) and may create stage records
effects.leadsTo: redirects to project details or event view depending on type
effects.check: Click Publish, ensure required validations run and a success message appears.

effects.does: Switches the mode to RFQ (if not already).
effects.affects: sets event mode to RFQ; may warn that existing data will be reset
effects.check: When clicked, verify a warning appears and after confirming, the UI shows RFQ‑specific fields.

effects.does: Opens the template selector to choose a pre‑filled project template.
effects.affects: loads template data into the form; may reset existing line items after confirmation
effects.check: Select a template and confirm the line‑item table is populated accordingly.

effects.does: Adds custom columns to the line‑item table.
effects.affects: updates UI column configuration; does not change backend data until saved
effects.check: Choose a column and verify it appears in the table header.

effects.does: Opens the project details drawer (title, description, etc.).
effects.affects: allows editing of project metadata which will be sent on save
effects.check: Edit the title and confirm the change is reflected in the title field.

effects.does: Opens the price‑components editor for the selected line item.
effects.affects: adds or edits price component objects that affect the `price` column calculation
effects.check: Add a component and verify the total price column updates.

effects.does: Opens the participants management drawer.
effects.affects: adds/removes vendor participants which are stored in `audience_company_uuids`
effects.check: Invite a vendor and ensure it appears in the participants list.

effects.does: Shows the savings calculation panel.
effects.affects: calculates and displays potential savings based on line‑item pricing; does not persist until publish
effects.check: Verify that the panel displays a numeric savings value after line items are entered.

effects.does: Navigates to the Terms & Conditions section (scrolls down).
effects.affects: nothing
effects.check: Click and confirm the view jumps to the T&C area.

effects.does: Opens the schedule drawer to set start time, duration and end time.
effects.affects: sets `stage.start` and `stage.end` values used on publish
effects.check: Change the time and verify the displayed end time updates accordingly.

effects.does: Selects the RFQ tab (already selected).
effects.affects: nothing (already active)
effects.check: Tab is highlighted as active; clicking again does not change view.

effects.does: Navigates to the Events list page.
effects.affects: nothing
effects.check: Click and verify the URL changes to `/events` and the list loads.

effects.control: Enter the title of the project
effects.does: Allows the buyer to type the project title.
effects.affects: sets the `title` field in the draft payload
effects.check: Enter text and confirm it appears in the title input.

effects.control: Search vendors you want to add
effects.does: Searches and selects vendors to add as participants.
effects.affects: populates `audience_company_uuids` with selected vendor IDs
effects.check: Search for a vendor, select it, and verify it appears in the participants list.

effects.does: Displays the required Product column for each line item.
effects.affects: must be filled before saving/publishing; stored as `product_uuid` per line item
effects.check: Leave the column empty and attempt to publish; verify validation error appears.

effects.does: Displays the required Product Variant column for each line item.
effects.affects: stores `product_quality_uuid` per line item; locked when created from PR
effects.check: Edit a variant and ensure the change is reflected in the UI and payload.

effects.does: Allows entry of the quantity requested for each line item.
effects.affects: stores `quantity.value` and `quantity.unitSymbol` in the line‑item payload
effects.check: Enter a number and verify the value is saved after Save as draft.

effects.does: Allows entry of the delivery location for each line item.
effects.affects: stores location data in the line‑item object
effects.check: Select a location and confirm it appears in the column.

effects.does: Displays the price column (editable if allowed).
effects.affects: stores `price` per line item; influences total amount calculation
effects.check: Edit a price and verify total amount updates.

effects.does: Shows the quantity available column (read‑only).
effects.affects: displays supplier‑provided available quantity; not persisted by buyer
effects.check: Confirm the column is populated from backend data and cannot be edited.

effects.does: Shows the GST (tax) column for each line item.
effects.affects: adds tax information to the line‑item payload if edited
effects.check: Enter a GST rate and verify total amount reflects tax.

effects.does: Displays the calculated total amount for each line item.
effects.affects: computed from price, quantity and GST; not directly editable
effects.check: Change price or quantity and verify total amount updates accordingly.

rules.statement: Body: `title`, `description`, `status`, `draft_trade_request_uuids`, `audience_company_uuids`, `line_items` (kept + deleted, each `{status, uuid, quantity, product_uuid, product_quality_uuid}`), `terms_and_conditions:{clauses, attachments:[{type:"t_and_c", value:[{name, private_url}]}]}`, `show_unde

Each draft stage → `GET /v1/trade/:id/schema?response_type=template&additional_fields=order_details&l1_prices=true` (plus `&rfq_to_auction=true` when converting), then `GET /companies/audience_for_product?trade_request_uuid=<id>` — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:1143-1165, src/models/

Switching between RFI and RFQ/Auction warns "Switching event mode will reset existing data." and on save clears template, sheet, savings, currencies and ALL project participants — auctionConfiguration.jsx:390-407, 898-903, src/views/eventCreation/eventCreation.jsx:505-536

Title "Are you sure you want to award this vendor?", field "Quantity Offered *" pre-filled with the vendor's `participant_quantity` and unit suffix; info "TR is pending for this line item." when unscored — src/components/dataGrid/formatters/comparisonSelectionFormatter.jsx:29-74

First save → `POST /event_groups` `{status:"draft", title, line_items:[{product_uuid, quantity:{unitSymbol,value}, product_quality_uuid, serial_number, pr_line_item_uuid, pr_id}]}`; later saves → `PATCH /event_groups/:id` — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:2259-2269, src/redux/project/a

Drawer disabled when fromPR, `isEditingAllowed=false` or `isAddNewStage`; variant shows "Variant of product cannot be modified", quantity/unit " 'Quantity Requested' and 'Unit of Measurement' cannot be modified" (quantity still editable when fromPR) — src/views/projectCreation/components/projectLine

Publish never stores the returned stage uuids (only Save as draft does), so a retry after a failed project PATCH (e.g. 712) POSTs every stage again — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:1826-1839 vs 1516-1536

Title: "Send to Auction Team" / project title truncated to 45 / "Publish Event"; OK text "Send to Auction Team" or "Publish"; Cancel is "Edit Schedule" and opens the schedule drawer — src/views/eventCreation/components/footer/confirmModal.jsx:52-60, 91-103

choosing "Custom duration" first sets end to undefined; closing the popover then Save passes (NaN comparisons) and publish fails "Please add end time for the event" — stageSchedulerCard.jsx:302-314. Backend has no end>start / end>now check (trade-stages.md part 8): candidate API test with past `bid_

Changing an existing template asks "Do you really want to change the template?" (project) / "Changing template will reset data. Are you sure?" (quick-create), OK "Yes" — templateSelection.jsx:349-360, src/translations/en.json eventCreation.handleTemplateDataReset
In project creation `product`, `creator_quantity`, `variant` are locked; PR events also lock READ_ONLY_WIDGETS_IN_PR_TO_AUCTION and `blockEditFromPr` widgets — templateSelection.jsx:248-272

AI RFP → `POST /ask_ai_chats/rfp_questions`, then `GET /external_requests/:uuid`; the AI button needs project line items — src/views/eventCreation/components/aiRfpGenerator/api.js:3-11, src/views/eventCreation/eventCreation.jsx:1854-1876

Currency prefix = selected base currency label, else template currency (symbol or code per stored preference), else dashboard default; price/amount columns get the selected base symbol — src/views/eventCreation/eventCreation.jsx:378-393, 1159-1195

`draftStageIds` without `projectId` → single draft stage is loaded and its title becomes the project title; with `projectId` → every listed stage is loaded and the last one is selected — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:2244-2257, 1157-1161, 1437-1445

`is_auction_on_base_price` = false for multi-product, else offersOn == base price; eRFX forces offersOn = line total before every publish, so eRFX always sends false — src/views/projectCreation/helpers.js:930-932, src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:1773-1776

`show_under_open_events` defaults to `true` and is sent on every publish/save even when the "Publish as open tender" checkbox is hidden (template config `openTenderEnabled` off) — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:218, 1565, 1867, src/views/eventCreation/components/footer/confirmModal.js

Saving the strategy drawer in project creation resets the stage title to the auto title computed with no other stages (`allModes: []`), overwriting a renamed title and its number — src/views/eventCreation/components/auctionConfiguration/auctionConfiguration.jsx:497-506
PR-created events: quantity `max` = the PR item's `quantity_open` (no tolerance) — src/views/projectCreation/components/projectLineItem.jsx:184, src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:320-330

Delete (Popconfirm "Are you sure to delete this line item?") is NOT disabled in a disabled drawer, and Save stays enabled for fromPR, so PR-created projects can delete items — src/views/projectCreation/components/projectLineItem.jsx:206-213, src/views/projectCreation/components/manageLineItemsModal.

Shown only when not RFQ→Auction, `allow_draft_project_creation` on, not (service-RFP grouping AND `groupServiceActivitiesInRfp`), auctions not routed to the auction team, and the current stage is not recurring — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:292-296, 3343-3345
Disabled with tooltip "Please select template for <stage title>" for any non-RFP stage without a template, or "Please add line items" — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:1457-1481
No participant in the project → "Please add participants to proceed!" (stops) — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:1604-1609
Tabs: "Project Details", one per stage (lot stages grouped under the lot title with "N item(s)"), then "Master QCS" — src/redux/project/selectors.js:1374-1406

Draft project reopen → `GET /event_groups/:id/get_line_items?filters={}&prevent_pagination=true`; a response without a `data` array navigates back with toast "Error while loading draft project" — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:1413-1423, src/redux/project/actions.js:291-306

Stage `status` in the payload = `"draft"` whenever a project id is attached or publishToDraft is true, else `"active"`; so eRFX stages are always created as drafts and go live only through the project PATCH — src/views/projectCreation/helpers.js:999-1000
`terms_and_conditions` is ALWAYS present in the body, even when the caller passed no T&C (clauses undefined, attachments value []) — src/redux/project/actions.js:71-82
Clara summary panel renders when `isClaraEnabled` is FALSE and the project has a claraSummary (FE-15.2 states the inverse) — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:3405-3409
RFQ→Auction stage title = source title with the first "rfq" (case-insensitive) replaced by "Auction", fallback "Stage 1" — src/views/projectCreation/helpers.js:1120-1126
Publish with empty project title → "Please fill project title!" before any other check; a whitespace-only title passes (truthiness check) — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:1599-1602
Publish label: "Send to Auction team" when publishToDraft, "Save Recurring Event" when the CURRENT stage is recurring, else "Publish" — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:3390-3400
Save with nothing changed (same count, product, variant, quantity per index) → drawer closes, no API call — src/views/projectCreation/components/manageLineItemsModal.jsx:83-121
No items left → "Please add atleast one item to proceed!" — src/views/projectCreation/components/manageLineItemsModal.jsx:86-88, 127-130
After save, an untouched empty project title is auto-generated (`use_pr_number_in_title`) — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:2289-2301

Stage title "" (auto titles are never empty; reachable in single-stage quick-create) → `errors.title`, no specific toast, only the rollup "<title> - There are some errors in Title, please check and try again" when no other toast fired; not raised for basket + multi-product — src/views/projectCreatio
eRFX project publish OK → "Project created successfully", redirect to project details (details tab) — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:1873-1888

Non-project publish → "Event sent to Auction Team successfully" when publishToDraft else "Event created successfully"; eRFX redirects to the project of the first stage, classic to `/orders/:id?tab=<eventDetails>` — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:1891-1914

duplicate draft stages on retry rely on backend silently voiding the earlier same-mode draft (part 6) or 854 when two exist — trade-stages.md part 6; candidate test: publish → 712 → fix → publish, then count stages.

Per stage: "Starts on:" (date-time or "Now"), "Ending at: <date-time> (<duration>)", "Evaluation time:" when > 0, "Vendors invited:" de-duplicated count — src/views/eventCreation/components/footer/confirmModal.jsx:150-181
"Publish as open tender" checkbox only when template config `openTenderEnabled`, not publishToDraft and eRFX — src/views/eventCreation/components/footer/confirmModal.jsx:30-31, 194-213
Times are re-computed at render; "Now"-start stages show end = now + duration, and the modal does not re-check end ≥ now — src/views/eventCreation/components/footer/confirmModal.jsx:120-126

cases.title: Publish with empty project title displays validation error
cases.expected: The system stops execution and displays the error message 'Please fill project title!'.
cases.setup: Leave the project title field completely blank.

cases.title: Add Attachments modal opens successfully
cases.expected: The file attachment drawer or modal opens allowing document uploads.
cases.setup: Be on the quick-create event screen.

cases.title: Save event progress as draft
cases.expected: The project is saved successfully as a draft and a success confirmation is displayed.
cases.setup: Fill in the mandatory project title and at least one line item.
